title: Secrecy briefing at Kilo control and ostracism after the incident
place_text: Kilo control, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Well, when I was sent to KE control, I got a real strict briefing from Master Sergeant Gray

plain: In 1977, after an incident in the missile field at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an airman named Mario Woods says he was sent to Kilo control, a launch control post there, and given "a real strict briefing" about secrecy by a Master Sergeant Gray, and was shunned afterward. Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels this from his own experience, also naming a Colonel Spraker.
